title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1991-03-17
lineage: The Master Cassettes were played  back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a  Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF  done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were  created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and  Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
source: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4s w/6" diameter plexiglass plates directly behind the  rear pickups of the capsules> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS cassette masters  Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Official Taping Section 8 Ft. Stand (Sec. 128, Row C, seat 4) .

ai_review.summary: A solid tour opener with standout debut of “Reuben and Cherise” and strong highlights in both sets; recording sounds decent though the source is unclear.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this early‑1991 show as a great way to kick off the tour, noting tight playing and the historic first performance of “Reuben and Cherise,” which even elicits an enthusiastic crowd reaction. No specific audio issues are mentioned, so the recording is assumed to be listenable despite the unknown source type.

ai_rating.rationale: Two highly positive reviews highlight a strong musical performance and no reported sound problems; limited review count reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on sound clarity, mix, or any flaws, implying the recording is acceptable but its exact source (soundboard/audience) is unspecified.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers mention highlights in both sets, describing the concert as a strong start to the tour with good pacing throughout.
